thread:
Nina (Design): Quick riff: what if the roles table shows a single-line summary under the role name like "Key perms: Manage billing · Remove members · Manage apps" and the full permission matrix is behind an expand area. Sketch: https://staging.redwood.design/role-summary-v3 :sparkles:
Ravi (PM): I like that. Two asks: make the default invite role explicit in org settings and make SSO wording unambiguous (enforced vs optional). Current wording trips customers.
Diego (Frontend): Implementation notes: avoid hover-only affordances. Use a visible caret button that is keyboard focusable. We'll virtualize rows for big orgs and persist expand state in session storage.
Avery (UX Research): In 6 unmoderated sessions participants scanned the left column for verbs. They ignored generic labels like "Admin". Recommend 3-verb summary and caption: "Shown are the most-used permissions; expand to see all."
Zoe (Accessibility): Contrast and semantics: the summary line must have a contrast ratio >= 4.5:1 for body text. Also the caret must have aria-expanded and aria-controls. Prefer native buttons for chips.
Nina (Design): Microcopy options for SSO toggle: (A) "Enforce SSO for all org sign-ins" (B) "Allow email/password sign-in" (toggle off). Which is clearer?
Ravi (PM): Use verb-first language: "Require SSO for all sign-ins". Add help text: "When enabled, email/password sign-ins are disabled for everyone." Add a small link: "Learn how this affects service accounts."
Diego (Frontend): For audit nav: propose a small inline action "View permission history" that deep-links to /orgs/:orgId/audit?filter=role:ROLE_ID&event=permission_change. We'll expose a keyboard shortcut too: when a role row is focused press "." then "h" to open history.
Avery (UX Research): Test script additions: tasks — identify who can change billing, open permission history for a role, invite a new user and confirm default role applied. Include keyboard-only and NVDA/VoiceOver testers.
Zoe (Accessibility): ARIA details: for the summary chips use aria-describedby referencing a hidden short description for screen readers: e.g., "priority-perms-desc-ROLE_ID" that reads the full verbs. Also announce expansion with polite aria-live region: "Permissions expanded for <Role>".
Nina (Design): Copy tweak: replace "Manage all" with task phrases. Example: instead of "Full access" use "Manage org settings & billing". Keep labels under 26 chars.
Diego (Frontend): CSS snippet for focus and non-color state:
```css
.role-row:focus-within{outline:3px solid var(--focus);outline-offset:2px}
.summary-chip{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;padding:4px 8px;border-radius:6px}
.summary-chip[aria-pressed=\"true\"]{box-shadow:0 0 0 3px rgba(2,132,199,0.12)}
```
Diego (Frontend): We'll add a star icon for the org default role and make it exposed via aria-label "Default invite role".
Ravi (PM): Invite flow change: show top-of-modal line: "Default role assigned to new invites: <Role>. Change". If inviter picks a different role show a short inline confirmation: "This invite will assign <Role>".
Avery (UX Research): Metrics to capture: expand_summary(role_id), open_permission_history(role_id), override_default_role. We'll analyze whether summaries reduce time-to-task.
Zoe (Accessibility): Also check keyboard order: ensure user can reach the expand button immediately after the role name. No hidden focus traps.
Nina (Design): Action items:
- @Diego: add aria attributes, focus styles, default-role star + deep-link (ETA next sprint)
- @Zoe: produce contrast recommendations and aria copy for the hidden descriptions (ETA Tue)
- @Avery: recruit 6 admins + 3 screen reader users; add tasks to script (ETA Thu)
- @Ravi: finalize SSO and invite microcopy, add note about service accounts (ETA Wed)
- @Nina: update mocks and include short Loom demo (ETA Mon)
